address: Unit 12100-1201 (FB), Level 2, The Galleria Al Maryah Island, Adgm Square, Al Maryah Island, Abu Dhabi
bio: Under the same management as Beirut Sur Mer, this restaurant offers just the thing for refuelling after a gruelling day of shopping around Abu Dhabi. The colourful space is decorated with floral printed chairs, vibrant vines adorned with pink flowers, a massive Sakura tree in the centre and an inviting open kitchen to watch the chefs at work. Served with a heartfelt smile, the Lebanese dishes are designed for sharing and generously sized; they are full of flavour and founded upon quality ingredients. Be sure to leave room for their delicious kunafa.
